sources.title: Run Qwen3-0.6B-heretic API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: This model is a decensored version of the Qwen/Qwen3-.6B, created using the Heretic v1.3.0 tool. It retains the core capabilities of the Qwen3 series while significantly reducing refusal rates, with 5 refusals per 100 queries compared to 57/100 in the original model.

sources.title: Run Qwen3-0.6B-heretic API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: While the original Qwen3-0.6B model had 53 refusals out of 100, this 'heretic' variant shows only 8 refusals out of 100, indicating a much less restrictive output. Key Capabilities Decensored Output: Significantly reduced refusal rate compared to the base model, allowing for broader content generation.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
